title: GET /api/integration/enforcement-rules (answer)
description: Integration token only. Every current rule snapshot (one per device with an HA user, parental controls included). The integration fetches it at start and whenever status.enforcement.rules_hashes differs from what it holds; it replaces its whole set with it.

control_paths.description: Control path of every device in snapshots, outside the versioned snapshot body (docs/enforcement.md#control-paths-next-to-the-snapshots).
